hero.p2: Between 17:00 and 21:00 a hotel's consumption peaks. The Lemnion battery absorbs this peak, so you stay below your contracted capacity and avoid penalties.
hero.p3: The government stimulates energy storage with substantial subsidies. Combine this with revenue from charging sessions and a lower energy bill. That is how your investment pays back fast.
hero.p1: Lemnion, together with Stroomlijnen, builds one total solution that helps your hotel save, earn and become more sustainable, from battery storage to smart EV chargers.
vp.text: We deliver one smart platform (EMS) that connects battery storage, EV chargers and optionally solar panels in your hotel. This lets you save costs by preventing peak load, capturing subsidies and becoming self-sufficient, so your guests can charge sustainably.
probleem.label: The problem
probleem.h2: Your hotel is growing, but your power grid is not
probleem.intro: Hotels want to become more sustainable, expand and offer guests the best service. But the grid connection is a bottleneck. Grid operators have waiting times of months to years. Want to know how it looks for your hotel? Then use our grid congestion postcode check. Meanwhile energy costs rise, sustainability stalls and guest comfort is at risk. These are the five main challenges hotels face:
probleem.c1p: Want to add 50 rooms, a wellness area or a conference hall? The grid operator says: no heavier connection available. The blueprints are ready, but the plug literally cannot go in. Charging hubs for guests stay impossible too, because the connection capacity is fully taken.
probleem.c2p: Switching from gas boilers to heat pumps, or from gas stoves to induction, demands enormous electrical capacity. Without a heavier connection, hotels are forced to keep burning gas.
probleem.c3h: Extreme consumption peaks and maximum load
probleem.c3p: Between 17:00 and 21:00 consumption peaks: kitchens, saunas, lifts, hundreds of guests showering. Exceed your contracted capacity? Then the grid operator hits you with sky-high penalties.
probleem.c4p: What to do with surplus energy? Feeding it back to the grid is not always possible or allowed anymore, and can even cost money. Store your own solar power and use it when you need it.
probleem.c5h: Replace the diesel generator? Manage power outages
probleem.c5p: Many hotels keep a diesel generator for emergencies. Want to get rid of it and replace it with a battery? That is possible. With a smart battery system you always have backup power, without emissions and without maintenance.
voordelen.intro: Lemnion does not just deliver batteries and chargers. We also create new revenue models for your hotel, from upsell to your guests to advertising on fast chargers.
voordelen.c1p: Install chargers or fast chargers at your hotel and earn per charging session. Guests, passers-by and local residents all charge with you. That generates 24/7 income.
voordelen.c2p: Offer a guaranteed charging spot at booking. An extra service that convinces guests to choose your hotel and generates additional revenue.
voordelen.c3p: Fast chargers have large screens. Show guests while they wait: "Coffee & pastries in our restaurant" or "10% off your next stay". That is direct conversion.
voordelen.c4p: The Lemnion EMS connects to your Property Management System through APIs. Create smart upsell packages: charger + room + breakfast in one booking.

usp.label: Our Unique Market Position
usp.c1p: Our partner imports hardware directly from the factory and provides its own firmware. Spare parts in stock in the Netherlands.
usp.c2p: Battery + EMS + OCPP 2.0.1 charging + 25 kW DC-coupled solar in one platform. One contract, one invoice, one phone number. Everything from one partner | no hassle with separate parties.
usp.c3p: The only programmable energy management system. No fixed profiles, no closed cloud platforms | tailor-made Python strategies per location.
usp.c4p: LFP chemistry → per-cell BMS monitoring → liquid cooling → built-in fire suppression → emergency stop with AC contactor → integration with the fire alarm panel. UL 9540A, UL 1973, UL 1642, IEC 62933-5-2.
usp.c5p: 25 kW+ MPPT directly on the DC bus. No conversion losses. Maximum yield from your solar panels | every kWh generated goes straight into your battery.
usp.c6p: Engineering, installation, commissioning, 24/7 monitoring, parts, support. Everything included in one transparent price | no hidden costs afterwards.
scenarios.label: Where do I start
scenarios.h2:
Build step by step
towards energy independence
scenarios.intro: Every hotel is different. That is why Lemnion builds your energy system modularly, from simple battery storage to a complete ecosystem with solar panels, EMS and EV chargers. Start where you want, expand when you are ready.
scenarios.s1p: A battery system that stores cheap night-time energy and releases it during the day, with backup power when the grid fails.
scenarios.s1b1p: Charge from the grid during cheap off-peak hours (40-60% lower rate) and use stored power during expensive peak hours.
scenarios.s1b2p: 261 kWh of LFP storage keeps critical systems running during a grid outage, so guests notice nothing.
scenarios.s1b3p: The battery absorbs peak load, so the transport capacity component on your energy bill drops immediately.
scenarios.s2p: The Energy Management System is the brain that optimises everything automatically. It gets to know your hotel, responds to prices and gives you full insight.
scenarios.s2b1p: The EMS learns your hotel's consumption patterns and optimises charging and discharging, without you lifting a finger.
scenarios.s2b2p: See exactly where every kilowatt goes. Live consumption, battery status, grid import and export, and savings in one overview.
scenarios.s2b3p: With dynamic energy prices the EMS reacts in real time. It discharges during expensive hours and charges when rates drop.
scenarios.s3p: Use your existing solar panels or have new ones installed. Store every kilowatt instead of feeding it back at unfavourable rates.
scenarios.s3b1p: Store surplus solar power in your battery and use it when your hotel needs it or when prices are highest.
scenarios.s3b2p: With solar and storage combined, typical hotels cover most of their daily electricity needs from their own installation.
scenarios.s3b3p: Every kilowatt from your own roof reduces CO₂ emissions. That is becoming increasingly important for guests, chains and regulations.
scenarios.s4p: Add fast DC chargers, powered by your stored solar energy. The EMS manages the load dynamically. Guests charge, you earn.
scenarios.s4b1p: Charge guests for charging sessions. A single charger can generate significant extra revenue per year, straight to your bottom line.
scenarios.s4b2p: Offer fast charging as a distinguishing service. Guests leave fully charged and your hotel becomes the first choice for EV drivers.
scenarios.s4b3p: With the rapid adoption of EVs across Europe, you position your hotel ready for the coming decade.
